TL: DR 

Your avatar can be updated faster, and you can also rely on shader & addon library of creators to update your avatar without having to do it yourself

That could maybe work for liltoon, but poiyomi is essentially designed against this idea, particularly "locking shaders" is actually required for the custom fallback shader option to work, and also poiyomi will remove unused code sections when locking, so many combinations of options. I don't know how efficient it is a run time (I just trust the process), but it means poiyomi using avatars take a long time to first build.

The main issue with delta patches is that you have to compress the asset bundle in a less efficient manner to have delta patches actually work. Right now the bundles are compressed in a way that prioritize file size over being comparable. 

But yeah, AppImages need to be build to support those delta updates

details:
With Avatars 4.0 hinted at, let's take advantage to add Delt Patching: Updating only the files that need to be patched instead of the entire asset bundle.

We don't need to re-upload an entire 80MB to 150MB asset bundle every time an avatar is updated. VRChat should implement Delta Patching for more efficient asset updating and bandwidth savings. This can allow creators to update their avatars faster and spend fewer resources on updating. AKA Github style updating

The Current Problem is that for every minor tweak or update, you need to update your entire avatar asset bundle. This is a waste of time and resources for both the player and the bandwidth costs. This is even worse when a shader or avatar addon needs to be manually updated across EVERY avatar.

- Shaders have to manually be updated when they break over time

- Addons like GoGo Loco also break down

- Sometimes you just remove or add a single item

Using Delta Patching, you can even update the shaders and the addons without updating the avatar by using an existing approved repo, or manually choose a version of the shader or addon for the avatar you're currently wearing, even if it's a public avatar. 

In Summary, Delta Patching gives creators a faster way to update their avatars without having to constantly deal with long uploads. In some cases, without even having to open Unity or while on a break
title: Delta Patching for Avatar 4.0
